department: Department of Mathematics, Statistics and Physics

deadline.value: The catalog gives no department deadline for this PhD; the Graduate School priority date for international Fall applicants is March 1.
deadline.quote: International Student Priority: March 1 Priority: August 1 $75 Secondary: April 30 Secondary: September 30 $135

gre_subject.value: The GRE subject test in mathematics or physics is recommended but not required.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE subject test in mathematics or physics is recommended but not required.

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.
supervisor.quote: Admission to the PhD program in applied mathematics requires completion of an undergraduate degree in mathematics, statistics or physics

funding.value: The catalog gives no funding rule for this PhD; the Graduate School's assistantship range is not a per-student guarantee.
funding.quote: assistantships for 20 hours of work per week for a nine-month period range from $5,800 to $25,000

entry_route.value: Applicants need an undergraduate degree in mathematics, statistics or physics, and a previous master's degree raises the GPA bar to 3.250.
entry_route.quote: as well as an overall GPA of 3.000 overall (3.250 if the student has a previous master’s degree)

notes: The catalog lists the PhD as Applied Mathematics only. Department web pages are blocked.
name: PhD in Applied Mathematics
